description: One machine-readable record per ledgered claim. Fields mirror the repository structure: tier per epistemic-ledger/TIERS.md, verdict status in the corpus's working vocabulary, kill-id for killed claims, census at landing, and repo-relative links to the owning Lean module and whitepaper dossier. See epistemic-ledger/SCHEMA.md for the mapping note, including the tier-dialect warning.

census_at_landing.description: Corpus census at the landing that produced this verdict, in the ledger's strict/total/modules figures. Null (whole object or per-field) when not recorded — an explicit unknown, never an estimate.

claim.description: The claim, stated at its tier, in one or two sentences.

dossier.description: Repo-relative path of the whitepaper dossier recording the verdict, or null when none exists.

evidence.description: Evidence qualifier per TIERS.md convention, e.g. 'Lean proof', 'Lean refutation', 'numerical', 'audit memo', 'statement pin', 'Lean statement; proof open'.

kill_id.description: Registered kill identifier (e.g. K-CLS-B). REQUIRED (non-null) iff status is 'killed'; null otherwise.

module.description: Repo-relative path of the owning Lean module, or null when the entry has no module (e.g. an audit kill).

status.description: Verdict state: standing (holds as stated), killed (refuted / withdrawn, kill_id required), partial (holds at a named seam only), frontier (posed, open, unpriced or unproved).

tier.description: Epistemic tier per epistemic-ledger/TIERS.md (framework section 5). The pipeline log's shorthand dialect differs; see SCHEMA.md.

title: Epistemic Ledger Entry (thet-logos)
